notes.title: WHO'S THE BEST?
notes.content:
[h2]Beanrise Major Update December 18th[/h2]

[h3]Gameplay[/h3]

[*]Added World Competitive Game Mode
[*]Rebuilt Menu Interface & Settings:
   [*]Gameplay Settings
   ---- VHS Overlay - On/Off
   ---- Camera Motion - Motion/No Motion (Motion Sickness)
   ---- Show Crosshair - Yes/No
   ---- FPS Limiter - Off/60fps
   ---- Time Dilation In Fast Forward - (Float Slider)

   [*]Video Settings
   ---- Resolution
   ---- Full Screen Mode
   ---- Global Illumination Quality
   ---- Shadows Quality
   ---- Reflections Quality

   [*]Audio Settings
   ---- Master & Music Volume
   ---- Subtitles: On/Off

   [*]Mouse Settings
   ---- Aesthetic Rotation Lag: Enable/Disable
   ---- Mouse Sensitivity

[h3]World Competitive[/h3]
[*]The World Competitive Mode contains "Practice" & World Competitive" mode where players can now compete with each-other through the new developed World Loeaderboards System.
[*]The First Map of World Competitive Mode is now available and is called "Greece"
[*]World Tournaments Added - Now players can see and participate in Active World Tournaments that will contain a Prize Pool
[*]Steam Log-in is now required in order for World Competitive to work. "Practice" mode can be played offline.

[h3]Single Player[/h3]
[*]Steam Login is now required to Play Story Mode
[*]Fixed a bug where a player couldn't interact with the Notes in Justin's Apartment, while the "E" prompt showed either way (as suggested by: *Junon"
[*]Hardware Raytracing is now Disabled, to minimize FPS drop & decrease unnecessary GPU usage
[*]Added Unreal Engine's Mega Lights
[*]Minor Collision Bugs
[*]Rebuilt Navigation System for NPCs

notes.title: Beanrise Prerelease Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes Build 1.0.3

- Disabled Jump inside Elevator
- Added "Save Progress" message after "We need money" quest
- Added intro message "Byllis 1997"
- Fixed Save Progress progress bar glitch
- Added Task Update in "Lost Van"
- Fixed Manon Dialogue repeating when pressing E
- Built and added Faulty Cables
- Fixed Buy Place progress repeating bug
- Added Explanation to player after buying Metro Cafe
- Added Explanation to player in "Wood Cabinet" to build Settlements
- Tweaked Rank thresholds in Side Quests, to fill up voids between quests
- Fixed a bug in "Wood Cabinet" not spawning a wood plank sometimes.
- Added a Milk Bottle Model
- Built and added a Weighed Button in Sewer System
- Added a Faulty Cable in Sewer System
- Added leaking water to sewers to help player notice Leaking Sewers in Investigation
- Piled up Shortcut Obstacles for clearer understanding
- Removed a water tank where player could climb with no crate. Added a big box instead.
- Added water at the bottom of the chambers in Sewer Systems
- Added rest mode
- Fixed various Respawn bugs
- Completed the Byllis map (closed unfinished areas)
- Fixed collision bugs on the Bike Blueprint
- Created Independent User Interface for Low Battery HUD
- Added Gun recoil
- Fixed various clipping issues
- Tweaked Savers spawn in quests
- Fixed a "Location Complete" Repeating bug
- Added Credits & Ending
